title: Kenya Road Loop + Diani Coast + Istanbul Hostel
overview:
- **Dates:** LAX Sat Dec 26 → LAX **Sat Jan 16**. 21 nights: **17 Kenya**, 2 Istanbul (hostel), 2 on planes.
- **Route:** Nairobi rest → Ol Pejeta 2n → Lake Nakuru 2n (NYE) → Mara conservancy 3n → Naivasha 1n → Nairobi 2n (Sheldrick, giraffes) → **Diani Beach 5n** (+ Shimba Hills) → airport hotel → Istanbul hostel 2n → home.
- **Safari = one private camping crew, all road (Dec 29–Jan 6).** No rental car needed: vehicle + driver-guide included. Coast by short flight.
- **Parks (5–6):** Ol Pejeta, Lake Nakuru, Mara conservancy, Lake Naivasha, Shimba Hills (+ Hell's Gate / Kisite optional).
- **Budget: ~$6,170 pp** (incl. flights + $300 contingency). Jan 16 adds 7 days ≈ +$900 vs the Jan 9 plan; extra days are cheap beach/city days.
- **Closer to $5.5k:** yellow fever done (−$200), SGR train (−$120), skip Shimba (−$90), TK free hotel (−$50).
- **Fatigue:** max ~4.5–5h road/day, rest day before every long drive, lots of zero-travel beach days.

itinerary.title: Fly toward Nairobi
itinerary.details: Christmas at home. TK10 LAX 19:45 → IST 19:00 next day (~13h). Sleep on Kenya time.

itinerary.title: Connect at IST
itinerary.details: ~1.5h airside connect (tight but legal). TK607 20:30 → NBO 03:05.

itinerary.title: Land + rest day
itinerary.details: Land 03:05. Pre-booked taxi (~20m) to budget guesthouse near JKIA/Langata (room held from Dec 27). Sleep. Zero travel. Shop for snacks, SIM.

itinerary.title: Drive north to Ol Pejeta
itinerary.details: Crew pickup ~08:30. ~4h via Nanyuki, equator stop. Camp set at OPC campsite. PM: chimp sanctuary + sunset drive.

itinerary.title: Rhinos + Mt Kenya
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn + late drives. Black/white rhino, lion, elephant, Grevy's zebra. Optional lion tracking (~$70; not budgeted).

itinerary.title: Road to Nakuru + NYE in camp
itinerary.details: 4–5h via Nyahururu (Thomson's Falls stop). Camp inside Lake Nakuru NP. Quiet New Year's Eve by the fire.

itinerary.title: Nakuru day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn drive to Baboon Cliff. Rhino, Rothschild giraffe, flamingos/pelicans, maybe tree-climbing lions. Siesta.

itinerary.title: Road to the Mara conservancy
itinerary.details: ~4.5–5h via Mau Narok + Narok. Lunch stop Narok. Camp in Enonkishu (or Pardamat/Ol Chorro). Short dusk drive.

itinerary.title: Full Mara day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Dawn + late drives, off-road, few vehicles. Big cats, plains game, newborn topi. Siesta.

itinerary.title: Maasai walk + last drives
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Morning walk with Maasai ranger. PM drive. Night drive if conservancy allows. Tip crew tomorrow.

itinerary.title: Road to Naivasha
itinerary.details: ~4–4.5h via Narok + Mai Mahiu. Lakeshore camp by mid-afternoon. Hippos at dusk. Optional boat (~$20 pp).

itinerary.title: Hell's Gate option + back to Nairobi
itinerary.details: Optional early Hell's Gate bike (2–3h; +$55, not budgeted). 2.5–3h to Nairobi guesthouse. Crew finishes; tip them.

itinerary.title: Baby elephants + giraffes
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Sheldrick orphanage 11:00 ($20, book online). Giraffe Centre (~$15). Uber/Bolt. Laundry, repack for the beach.

itinerary.title: Fly to the coast
itinerary.details: ~1h15 Jambojet NBO → Ukunda (~$110). 10–15m tuk-tuk to guesthouse. ~3h door to door. Afternoon swim.

itinerary.title: Beach day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. White sand, warm Indian Ocean (~28°C). Colobus Conservation walk (~$10). Cheap Swahili food.

itinerary.title: Shimba Hills day trip
itinerary.details: ~45m each way. Shared vehicle + guide. Elephants, sable antelope (only place in Kenya), Sheldrick Falls walk. Back for sunset.

itinerary.title: Free day / Kisite snorkel option
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Optional Kisite marine park dhow + snorkel + dolphins (~$70, not budgeted). Or just beach.

itinerary.title: Last beach day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Rest before the long trip home. Pack.

itinerary.title: Fly back to Nairobi
itinerary.details: Afternoon Jambojet Ukunda → NBO (~1h15). Hotel shuttle 10–20m. ~3h door to door. Early night.

itinerary.title: Early flight to Istanbul
itinerary.details: Wake ~02:45, 10–20m to JKIA. TK608 04:50 → IST 11:45 (~7h). Havaist bus + tram to hostel. Nap, easy evening.

itinerary.title: Cheap Istanbul day
itinerary.details: Zero travel. Blue Mosque (free), Hagia Sophia gallery (€25) or exterior, Grand + Spice Bazaar, ferry to Kadıköy (~$1). Street food.

itinerary.title: Fly home
itinerary.details: Easy morning. Havaist to IST. TK9 ~14:30 → LAX ~18:15 same day (~13h45).

practical:
## Entry
- Kenya eTA $30, **etas.gov.ke only**. Türkiye visa-free. Passport 6+ mo, 2 blank pages.

## Flights
- TK10 19:45→19:00+1. TK607 **20:30 → 03:05**. 1.5h connect: tight. Missed → next night; Ol Pejeta 1n shorter.
- Return TK608 Jan 14 04:50 → IST 11:45; TK9 Jan 16.

## Istanbul hostel
- Book a **private double** in a hostel (~$50/room). Dorm beds ~$15 pp if you don't mind sharing.
- Sultanahmet = walk to sights. Check reviews for heat (Jan is ~3–9°C) and lockers.
- Havaist bus IST → Sultanahmet/Taksim ~$6, then tram.

## Do we need a rental car? No.
- Safari days: the camping operator's 4x4 + driver-guide is in the crew price. You never drive.
- Self-drive is possible (e.g. Roadtrip Africa Land Cruisers + rooftop tent), but **Mara conservancies don't allow self-drive vehicles**, you'd do every 4–5h drive yourselves on the left, and an 8-day self-drive package starts ~€1,730 pp: not cheaper.
- Nairobi: Uber/Bolt. Diani: tuk-tuks. Shimba Hills: shared tour vehicle.

## Road reality
- Longest days: Dec 31 (4–5h), Jan 2 (4.5–5h). Rest day before each.
- All transfers in crew vehicle; no driving yourself, no night driving.

## Fees
- KWS Nakuru $90 new vs $60 old (court case). OPC + Mara conservancies not KWS. Cashless (card/M-Pesa).

## Operator must confirm in writing
- Mara conservancy mobile camping allowed + fee. Per-day rate incl. festive days. No hidden repositioning.

## Health (CDC)
- Yellow fever recommended outside Nairobi. Malaria pills from Dec 27 to 7 days after leaving Kenya (coast is higher risk). DEET; dengue on coast.

## Camping
- Walk-in tents, beds, bucket shower, toilet tent. Askari at night. Laikipia/Nakuru nights ~8–12°C: fleece.

## Money/safety
- ~130 KES/$. Crisp USD for tips. Kenya Level 2: Uber/Bolt, no night walks. Plastic bags banned.

Rules:
- **Max ~5h road:** met (Dec 31, Jan 2 ≤5h).
- **No back-to-back ≥3.5h:** met. Rest day before every long drive.
- **Min 2 nights/stop:** yes except transit nights (Nairobi arrival, Naivasha, JKIA).
- **Rest days:** 9 with zero travel + arrival day.
- SGR option makes Jan 8 + Jan 13 ~7h each: tiring; flight kept in plan.
